items.title: Canadian and US Fish Found With Rare Contagious Skin Cancer, Scientists Discover
items.summary: Scientists have identified a rare and unusual form of skin cancer affecting brown bullhead catfish living in Lake Memphremagog, a freshwater lake shared by the United States and Canada. The discovery is significant because researchers found evidence that the cancer can spread directly from one fish to another, making it the first confirmed case of a transmissible cancer in freshwater fish. items.title: Kaylee Hottle Death Investigation: Cause of Death Revealed After Maryland Crash
items.summary: Deaf Actress Known for “Godzilla” Films Dies at 18 Following Tragic Accident The entertainment world is mourning the loss of young actress Kaylee Hottle, a talented deaf performer who gained international recognition for her role in the “Godzilla” franchise. Authorities have now revealed the cause and manner of her death following a fatal vehicle accident in Maryland. According to the Maryland Chief Medical Examiner’s Office, Hottle died from multiple blunt force injuries caused by the crash.
